# ESP32 Wireless Defense Lab v1.0.0

First maintained defensive release.

## Highlights

- Passive deauthentication/disassociation management-frame observation
- Burst-based anomaly alerts with source/BSSID, reason code, RSSI and channel context
- Nearby Wi-Fi inventory with SSID, BSSID, RSSI, channel and advertised security mode
- Per-channel event analytics
- Responsive local management dashboard
- Mandatory first-boot Wi-Fi/admin credential replacement
- HTTP Digest authentication and per-boot CSRF protection
- AES-256-GCM application-level protection for local management credentials
- Configurable monitor channel and alert threshold
- Optional SSD1306 128x64 OLED support
- Task watchdog and persistent event/settings storage
- PlatformIO build, host detector tests and firmware size budget
- Browser installer and combined first-install firmware image

## Maintained scope

This release is receive-only and defensive. It does not maintain deauthentication transmission, Evil Twin impersonation, credential collection, handshake/PMKID harvesting, beacon flooding, BLE spam, or HID attack modules.

## Firmware files

- esp32-defense-lab-full.bin — complete first-install image, flash at offset 0x0
- esp32-defense-lab-ota.bin — application image for compatible update workflows
- SHA256SUMS.txt — SHA-256 checksums for both firmware files

## Validation

Automated host tests and ESP32 compilation are verified by GitHub Actions. Real RF sensitivity, optional OLED hardware and long-duration stability still require physical classic ESP32 testing.
